snippet.title: Birth Of X - First Trailer. (Official Video).
snippet.description:
THE GAME ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3899630/Birth_Of_X

Birth Of X is an atmospheric psychological horror about the pain of loss. A mysterious box left at your doorstep sets off a chain of terrifying events. Solve symbolic puzzles and face what crawls behind you…
